title: support.diagnosed, as Fabric Inbox emits it
description: B-162: why a reply agent did not answer a message, as the turn reads it, on the server's events feed (/fabric/v1/events, list_agent_events) as data.value. Once per run and cause: a held message retried later says it again only when the cause changes. A message whose knowledge lookup failed names no cause (an outage is not a gap), and a run that failed is retried rather than diagnosed. No sender, subject or text of the message; question is the model's English restatement with personal data removed. workers/agents/learning-events.ts.

address.description: The Cloudflare address the message came to.

cause.description: data: the knowledge has no answer (the message was held and its question reported as a gap); draft-or-check: the material was there but the answer was not sure or the checker did not approve it; person: the reply policy hands the message to a person; retrieval: the knowledge answers it but the turn's search missed it, named only by a second look.

rescued.description: Always false at the turn: a checked answer sent by a second look is a later event.
